hero.title: Activian — peaceful PvE guild with a champion mindset.
hero.lead: We protect neutrality, grow together, help guildmates, and move step by step toward becoming the strongest guild on Gravity 21.

about.title: A neutral guild built on respect, discipline, and cooperation.
about.body1: Activian is a PvE guild in MU: Dark Epoch on Gravity 21. We keep peaceful relations with other guilds, avoid unnecessary conflict, and choose teamwork over chaos.
about.body2: Our goals are simple: preserve peace and neutrality, support every active member, perform well in guild activities, and become the best guild on the server through consistency rather than toxicity.
about.body3: PvP is not our daily identity. We fight only where the event rules make it meaningful, and even there we represent Activian with discipline.

peace.title: Peace
peace.text: Neutrality and calm relations with other guilds come first.

team.title: Teamwork
team.text: We help guildmates with advice, events, and progression when we can.

activity.title: Activity
activity.text: Members are expected to appear at least once per day whenever possible.

respect.title: Respect
respect.text: No toxicity, aggression, insults, or long conflicts.

rules.title: Rules every Activian member follows.
rules.warningText: up to three warnings may be issued for violations. Continued violations can lead to removal from the guild.

items.title: Respect everyone
items.text: Treat members, leaders, deputies, and other guilds calmly and fairly.

items.title: No toxicity
items.text: Insults, aggression, harassment, and drama in chat are not welcome.

items.title: End conflicts quickly
items.text: If a conflict starts, stop it as soon as possible and ask leadership for help if needed.

items.title: Help newcomers
items.text: If you know the answer, explain it. New players can grow into useful guildmates.

items.title: Support the guild
items.text: Join events, help teammates, and contribute to common progress.

items.title: Keep promises
items.text: Auction deals and item agreements must be respected once accepted.

events.title: Event rules for organized PvE play and meaningful PvP moments.
events.intro: MU: Dark Epoch rewards active participation in guild activities, bosses, limited-time events, and cooperative progression. Activian treats events as team work: arrive prepared, follow calls, and support the group.
events.note: Specific event schedules and requirements may change in-game, so always check current announcements before joining.
items: Be online before the event starts whenever possible.
Prepare gear, potions, buffs, and inventory space in advance.
Follow calls from Tsunade, deputies, or the assigned event lead.
Prioritize guild objectives over personal arguments or random fights.
PvP is allowed only when the event format requires it.
Do not go AFK during organized activities without warning the group.
